knownRisks.risk: Table dependency: ai_brand_intelligence_v2 reads ai_brand_dna via clientId — if Brand DNA v1 row does not exist for a clientId, V2 will still produce a low-confidence profile (graceful degradation).
knownRisks.mitigation: Run V1 analysis (POST /ai/brand-intelligence/analyze) before requesting V2 for best results.

knownRisks.risk: Local drizzle table definition: aiBrandIntelligenceV2Table is defined inline in brandIntelligenceV2Service.ts (not in @workspace/db barrel). This is intentional — the team must not modify the locked barrel file. Migration must be applied before the service can write to the table.
knownRisks.mitigation: Apply integration/migrations/team-05.sql before deploying the api-server. Team 24 must coordinate migration order.

knownRisks.risk: Confidence scores for interior and fashion dimensions are lower on average (0.15–0.65) because they are inferred from general personality tags rather than domain-specific brand data. This is expected and surfaced via DimensionConfidence.gaps.
knownRisks.mitigation: Future enhancement: add domain-specific brand kit slots for interior and fashion to raise confidence.
